lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five vertical columns of high-intensity circular blobs are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in a grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of white spots, creating distinct grid-like nodes where the spots are centered within the lighter vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: At least five remoras (Echeneidae) are visible trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin and the ventral-lateral region.
